name: vllm_reshape_and_cache
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_reshape_and_cache.py. Scatters key/value (num_tokens,num_heads,head_dim) in {fp16,bf16} into paged KV caches per slot_mapping: key_cache 5D (num_blocks,num_heads,head_dim//x,block_size,x), value_cache 4D (num_blocks,num_heads,head_dim,block_size). slot_mapping is an int64 randperm(num_blocks*block_size)[:num_tokens] built by gen_inputs (num_blocks/block_size are scalar inputs; num_tokens from key shape). run() allocates the two zero caches, fixes kv_cache_dtype='auto' and k_scale=v_scale=1.0 (the fp8 path is not migrated), calls the in-place _custom_ops.reshape_and_cache, and returns (key_cache,value_cache). Unwritten slots stay zero in both ref and candidate. Default comparison validates both caches. Requires vLLM at eval time.
